title: a napkin that runs the math
excerpt: Pattern Bridge makes Amapola, a napkin that runs the math. Sketch a money decision, press play, and watch how it behaves.
content_html:
Sketch a money decision as blocks and wires, press play, and watch a year run before you live it. Here is one, playing now.
